articles.title_en: The Value of Ratings: Evidence from Their Introduction in Securities Markets
articles.title_cn: 评级的价值：来自证券市场引入的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the first-ever ratings for corporate securities. In 1909, John Moody published a book that partitioned the majority of listed railroad bonds into letter-graded ratings. These ratings had no regulatory implications and were largely explainable using publicly available information. We find that lower-than-market-implied ratings caused a rise in secondary market bond yields and that bonds that were rated experienced a substantial decline in their bid-ask spreads, consistent with reduced information asymmetries and improved liquidity. Our findings suggest that ratings can improve information transmission and highlight their potential value for the functioning of financial markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究有史以来的公司证券评级。在1909，约翰·穆迪出版了一本书，将大多数上市铁路债券划分为字母评级。这些评级没有监管影响，并且在很大程度上可以使用公开信息进行解释。我们发现，低于市场的隐含评级导致二级市场债券收益率上升，并且评级债券的买卖价差大幅下降，这与信息不对称的减少和流动性的改善相一致。我们的研究结果表明，评级可以改善信息传递并突显其对金融市场运作的潜在价值。

articles.title_en: Mandated versus Voluntary Adaptation to Natural Disasters: The Case of US Wildfires
articles.title_cn: 自然灾害的强制适应与自愿适应：以美国野火为例
articles.abstract_en: Despite escalating losses in climate-related disasters, adoption of protective technologies and behaviors is limited by risk misperception, externalities, and insurance market frictions. One response to these market failures is to mandate these investments. We measure the effect of California’s wildfire building codes on own and neighboring structure survival using comprehensive data on US homes exposed to wildfires since 2000. Differences across jurisdictions and vintages reveal remarkable resilience effects of building codes. Codes also increase survival of neighboring homes by reducing structure-to-structure spread. We then develop and estimate a model of social benefits of mandatory building standards versus other adaptation policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管气候相关灾害造成的损失不断增加，但保护性技术和行为的采用仍受到风险误解、外部性和保险市场摩擦的限制。 一对这些市场失灵的反应是强制进行这些投资。我们使用自2000以来暴露于野火的美国房屋的综合数据来衡量加州野火建筑规范对自身和邻近结构生存的影响。不同司法管辖区和年份的差异揭示了建筑规范显着的弹性效应。规范还可以通过减少结构间的扩散来提高邻近房屋的生存率。然后，我们开发并评估强制性建筑标准与其他适应政策的社会效益模型。

articles.title_en: Endogenous Treatment Models with Social Interactions: An Application to the Impact of Exercise on Self-Esteem
articles.title_cn: 具有社会互动的内源性治疗模型：运动对自尊影响的应用
articles.abstract_en: We address the estimation of endogenous treatment models with social interactions in both the treatment and outcome equations. We model the interactions between individuals via a game theoretic approach based on discrete Bayesian games. We employ a nested pseudo joint likelihood algorithm when obtaining the model’s parameters and provide relevant treatment effects and procedures for their estimation. Our empirical application examines the impact of an individual’s exercise frequency on their level of self-esteem. We find that an individual’s exercise frequency is influenced by their expectation of their friends’ exercise frequency. Moreover, an individual’s level of self-esteem is affected by their level of exercise and, at relatively lower levels of self-esteem, by the expectation of their friends’ self-esteem.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过治疗和结果方程中的社会相互作用来估计内源性治疗模型。我们通过基于离散贝叶斯博弈的博弈论方法对个体之间的交互进行建模。我们在获取模型参数时采用嵌套伪联合似然算法，并提供相关的治疗效果和估计过程。我们的实证应用研究了个人的锻炼频率对其自尊水平的影响。我们发现一个人的锻炼频率受到他们对朋友锻炼频率的期望的影响。此外，一个人的自尊水平受到锻炼水平的影响，在自尊水平相对较低的情况下，还会受到朋友自尊期望的影响。

articles.abstract_en: We study what changes to an agent’s decision problem increase her value for information. We prove that information becomes more valuable if and only if the agent’s reduced-form payoff in her belief becomes more convex. When the transformation corresponds to the addition of an action, the requisite increase in convexity occurs if and only if a simple geometric condition holds, which extends in a natural way to the addition of multiple actions. We apply these findings to two scenarios: a monopolistic screening problem in which the good is information and delegation with information acquisition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究代理人决策问题的哪些变化会增加她的信息价值。我们证明，当且仅当代理人的信念的简化形式回报变得更加凸时，信息才会变得更有价值。当变换对应于添加一个动作时，当且仅当一个简单的几何条件成立时，才会发生必要的凸性增加，该几何条件以自然的方式延伸到多个动作的添加。我们将这些发现应用于二场景：垄断筛选问题，其中商品是信息和信息获取的授权。

articles.abstract_en: We develop an assignment model of automation. Each of a continuum of tasks of variable complexity is assigned to either capital or one of a continuum of labor skills. We characterize conditions for interior automation, whereby tasks of intermediate complexity are performed by capital. Interior automation arises when low-skill wages are low and effective cost of capital in low-complexity tasks is high. Minimum wages make interior automation less likely. Higher capital productivity causes employment and wage polarization, changes the skill premium nonmonotonically, and reduces the real wage of workers with comparative advantage profiles close to that of capital.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了自动化分配模型。每个复杂程度各异的连续任务都被分配给资本或一连续的劳动技能。我们描述了内部自动化的条件，其中中等复杂性的任务由资本执行。当低技能工资较低且低复杂性任务的有效资本成本较高时，内部自动化就会出现。最低工资降低了室内自动化的可能性。较高的资本生产率会导致就业和工资两极分化，非单调地改变技能溢价，并降低具有接近资本比较优势的工人的实际工资。
